modules.title: 为什么第二次只发“继续”，模型不知道要继续什么
下一次请求怎样重新拿到刚才的表格

items.title: 模型只收到当前请求
items.text: 第二次调用如果只有“继续”，模型看不到上一轮的表格、目标和结果，无法确定要继续什么。

items.title: 产品从记录中找回资料
items.text: 应用可以从自己保存的聊天或任务记录中取回当前表格、未完成目标和上一轮结果。

items.title: 把必要资料放进新请求
items.text: 应用把找回的资料和“继续”一起发送，模型这次才有完成任务所需的内容。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 无状态不等于产品不能保存数据。对话历史可以保存在产品里，但每次调用仍只看实际发送的内容；保存记录和提供本轮背景是两件事。

lessonPractice.title: 服务端只收到一句“继续完成刚才的表格”，请求里没有表格或上一轮结果。模型应该如何获得背景？

options.label: 由应用在每次请求中重新附上当前表格、目标和相关上一轮结果
options.feedback: 请求本身无状态，模型只能使用这次收到的内容，应用需要重建必要背景。

options.label: 只发送“继续”，模型会根据用户账号自动恢复之前内容
options.feedback: 账号或会话存在不代表模型持有旧请求，缺少背景时“继续”没有可确定对象。

options.label: 让聊天界面保留旧表格即可，不必把它加入新请求
options.feedback: 界面存储服务于展示，只有实际组装进请求的内容才能被模型读取。

en.title: A server receives only Continue the previous table, with no table or prior result in the request. How should the model get context?

options.label: Have the application attach the current table, goal, and relevant prior result to each request
options.feedback: The request is stateless and the model can only use current input, so the application rebuilds required background.

options.label: Send only Continue and let the model recover previous content from the user account
options.feedback: An account or session does not mean the model retains prior requests, leaving Continue without a known object.

options.label: Keep the old table visible in the chat UI without adding it to the new request
options.feedback: UI storage supports display; only content assembled into the request can be read by the model.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 下一次不要只发“继续”。请把当前表格、还没完成的目标、上一轮结果和这次要输出的内容一起放进请求，并记录实际发送了什么，方便我确认模型拿到了必要背景。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Treat every model call as stateless: send the current task, required data, relevant history, and expected output. Do not send only Continue or rely on visible messages; inspect the actual request for required context.

learning.assumes: You have used chat or task pages that can refresh or reopen.
learning.outcome: You can tell that a model sees only the material in the current request and that the product supplies the background.

modules.title: Why does a second request containing only “continue” lack a task?
How the next request gets the earlier table

items.title: The model receives only this request
items.text: If the second call contains only “continue,” it lacks the earlier table, goal, and result.

items.title: The product retrieves saved material
items.text: The application can recover the current table, unfinished goal, and prior result from its records.

items.title: The new request includes what is needed
items.text: The application sends that material with “continue,” giving the model enough context this time.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: Stateless does not mean the product cannot save data. Conversation history may be stored, but each model call still sees only what was actually sent.
